dialogues.jp: 夕暮れ前の学校は、さすがに人が少なかった。
dialogues.en: The school was sparsely populated in the evening.
dialogues.text: The school was sparsely populated in the evening.

dialogues.jp:
ほんの少しだけ、様子が気になって見に来たが、
他の学生達だけではなく、月城もいなくなって
いた。
dialogues.en:
I came here to see how Tsukishiro was doing, but not only
were there a complete lack of students, but a complete lack
of her too.
dialogues.text:
I came here to see how Tsukishiro was doing, but not only
were there a complete lack of students, but a complete lack
of her too.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、どうせ月城のことだから、今日もずっと
ここにいたんだろうということは想像に難くな
い。
dialogues.en:
Well, even for Tsukishiro, it'd be hard to imagine a person
spending the entire day here.
dialogues.text:
Well, even for Tsukishiro, it'd be hard to imagine a person
spending the entire day here.

dialogues.jp: 「仕方ない……。帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Can't do anything about it... I'd head back."
dialogues.text: "Can't do anything about it... I'd head back."

dialogues.jp:
仕方ないとはどういうことかと思いながらも、
体育館裏を後にする。
dialogues.en:
Wallowing in my uselessness, I continued on through the back
of the gym.
dialogues.text:
Wallowing in my uselessness, I continued on through the back
of the gym.

dialogues.jp:
あそこは日曜の夕暮れにひとりでいるところじゃ
あない。
dialogues.en:
The park as well wasn't as crowded as one would expect for a
Sunday evening.
dialogues.text:
The park as well wasn't as crowded as one would expect for a
Sunday evening.

dialogues.jp:
相変わらず桜の花びらが舞う桜公園は、幻想的
な雰囲気を醸し出していた。
dialogues.en:
The sakura petals danced around the park as usual, giving
the environment an illusionary appearance.
dialogues.text:
The sakura petals danced around the park as usual, giving
the environment an illusionary appearance.

dialogues.jp:
特異な状況はたいてい見慣れると、大したこと
のないものに映るものだが、俺は未だにこの風
景を幻想的と感じている。
dialogues.en:
Despite seeing this sight often, and knowing that it's
nothing special, I still felt enchanted by the scenery.
dialogues.text:
Despite seeing this sight often, and knowing that it's
nothing special, I still felt enchanted by the scenery.

dialogues.jp:
薄桃色の花びらがはらはらと舞う様はなんとな
く心が安らぐ。
dialogues.en:
The fluttering of the weak, pink sakura petals somehow
relaxes the heart.
dialogues.text:
The fluttering of the weak, pink sakura petals somehow
relaxes the heart.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ……？　あいつは……」
dialogues.en: "Hmm....? Isn't that..."
dialogues.text: "Hmm....? Isn't that..."

dialogues.jp: 公園の端を見覚えのある女の子が歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
A familiar-looking girl was walking around at the other end
of the park.
dialogues.text:
A familiar-looking girl was walking around at the other end
of the park.

dialogues.jp:
あの特徴的な髪の色と、犯罪に近いちびっこさ
は、ひとりしかいない。
dialogues.en:
That unmistakable hair colour, and that petite form, there's
no doubt who it is.
dialogues.text:
That unmistakable hair colour, and that petite form, there's
no doubt who it is.

dialogues.jp: 「月城ー」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishirooo-"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishirooo-"

dialogues.jp:
ぽてぽてと歩いていた月城は、手を振っている
俺に気がつくと、進行方向をこちらに向ける。
dialogues.en:
The calmly walking Tsukishiro, upon noticing my voice and
waving, started advancing towards my direction.
dialogues.text:
The calmly walking Tsukishiro, upon noticing my voice and
waving, started advancing towards my direction.

dialogues.jp:
だからといって、走ってきたりはしないところ
が月城らしい。
dialogues.en:
That speed, without actually running... practically her
trademark.
dialogues.text:
That speed, without actually running... practically her
trademark.

dialogues.jp:
いつも制服姿しか見たことがないから、私服姿
はやけに新鮮だ。
dialogues.en:
She wasn't wearing her usual uniform this time, but instead
her own clothes.
dialogues.text:
She wasn't wearing her usual uniform this time, but instead
her own clothes.

dialogues.jp:
なんとなく、清楚なイメージの服がよく似合っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
The clothes, giving off an image of tidiness and properness,
fitted her perfectly.
dialogues.text:
The clothes, giving off an image of tidiness and properness,
fitted her perfectly.

dialogues.jp: 「どこかに出かけてたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Where are you going?"
dialogues.text: "Where are you going?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……はい、買い物に」
dialogues.en: "...I was shopping."
dialogues.text: "...I was shopping."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って、アリスは、小脇に抱えていた紙袋
を見せてくれる。
dialogues.en: As she spoke, she glanced at the paper bag she was holding.
dialogues.text: As she spoke, she glanced at the paper bag she was holding.

dialogues.jp: 「なに、これ。本？」
dialogues.en: "What's inside that... a book?"
dialogues.text: "What's inside that... a book?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……モーツァルト」
dialogues.en: "...Mozart."
dialogues.text: "...Mozart."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ＣＤか」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, a CD."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, a CD."

dialogues.jp: にしちゃあ、えらく大きな紙袋だ。
dialogues.en: The bag looks way too big for it to be that, though.
dialogues.text: The bag looks way too big for it to be that, though.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……レコード」
dialogues.en: "...Record."
dialogues.text: "...Record."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「レコード？　ああ、レコードな」
dialogues.en: "Record? ...Ohh, a record."
dialogues.text: "Record? ...Ohh, a record."

dialogues.jp:
最初はピンとこなかったが、ようやく思い出す。
テレビとかで時々見るヤツだ。
dialogues.en:
It didn't click in my mind at first, but then I remembered
seeing things like that on TV.
dialogues.text:
It didn't click in my mind at first, but then I remembered
seeing things like that on TV.

dialogues.jp:
「モーツァルトってことは、月城はクラシック
　なんか聴いてるんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Since that's Mozart, I suppose you listen to classical
music, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text:
"Since that's Mozart, I suppose you listen to classical
music, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp: 月城がこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: The usual nod from her.
dialogues.text: The usual nod from her.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……気持ちが、安らぐの」
dialogues.en: "...It makes me feel calm."
dialogues.text: "...It makes me feel calm."

dialogues.jp:
そういえば、クラシックなんかちゃんと聴いた
ことなかったな。
dialogues.en:
Speaking of which, I've never really listened to classical
music before.
dialogues.text:
Speaking of which, I've never really listened to classical
music before.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、それをいえばそもそもレコードで音楽を
聴いた事もなかったけど。
dialogues.en: Let alone having listened to a record being played.
dialogues.text: Let alone having listened to a record being played.

dialogues.jp: 「今度俺にも聴かせてくれよ」
dialogues.en: "Let me listen to it sometime."
dialogues.text: "Let me listen to it sometime."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、んー……と首を傾げている。傾げる首
がどんどん右へ｛かたむ／傾｝いていく。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro's head started inclining to her right, as she
stared thoughtfully at me, thinking.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro's head started inclining to her right, as she
stared thoughtfully at me, thinking.

dialogues.jp:
「あ、いや、ほんと今度でいいんだ、今度で。
　機会があればでいいから……」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, I mean, I really mean sometime, sometime. Whenever's a
good opportunity, that is..."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, I mean, I really mean sometime, sometime. Whenever's a
good opportunity, that is..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、手を左右に振って、やたらと困っている
月城の傾いた首を元に戻す。
dialogues.en:
I waved my hand frantically to dispel her fears, and the
worried Tsukishiro resumed her normal position.
dialogues.text:
I waved my hand frantically to dispel her fears, and the
worried Tsukishiro resumed her normal position.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: そして、月城はそう言ってこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: She nodded in agreement.
dialogues.text: She nodded in agreement.

dialogues.jp: 「そういえば、例の草は？」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, how's the plant?"
dialogues.text: "Anyway, how's the plant?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……見てきました」
dialogues.en: "...I already saw it."
dialogues.text: "...I already saw it."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「そっか……。なあ、帰るところだったんなら
　一緒に帰ろうぜ？　同じ方向なんだし」
dialogues.en:
"I see... then since you're heading back, want to go home
together? We live in the same general area, after all."
dialogues.text:
"I see... then since you're heading back, want to go home
together? We live in the same general area, after all."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、また、んー……と首を傾げている。
dialogues.en:
Her expression once again changed to one of perplex, as her
head tilted to the side.
dialogues.text:
Her expression once again changed to one of perplex, as her
head tilted to the side.

dialogues.jp: ……また、困らせちゃったかな。
dialogues.en: ...Looks like I annoyed her again.
dialogues.text: ...Looks like I annoyed her again.

dialogues.jp: 「あ、月城……あのな」
dialogues.en: "Um, Tsukishiro... well."
dialogues.text: "Um, Tsukishiro... well."

dialogues.jp: やっぱりまた今度でいいよ、と言おうとしたら、
dialogues.en: I was about to say "maybe next time" again, but,
dialogues.text: I was about to say "maybe next time" again, but,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: 月城は確かにそう言った。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro answered me first.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro answered me first.

dialogues.jp:
「よし、帰ろうぜ。そうだ、途中でチョコバナ
　ナおごってやるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Alright, let's go! I'd treat you to a chocolate banana on
the way."
dialogues.text:
"Alright, let's go! I'd treat you to a chocolate banana on
the way."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ほのかに笑みを浮かべながら、こくん
と頷いた。
dialogues.en: With a faint smile on her lips, Tsukishiro nodded to me.
dialogues.text: With a faint smile on her lips, Tsukishiro nodded to me.

dialogues.jp: ◆モーツァルト◆
dialogues.en: ◆Mozart◆
dialogues.text: ◆Mozart◆

dialogues.jp:
日曜日にも、月城は体育館裏にいるのだろうか
と気になり、様子を見に行った。
dialogues.en:
This evening, thinking that Tsukishiro would be behind the
gym as usual, I went there to check on her.
dialogues.text:
This evening, thinking that Tsukishiro would be behind the
gym as usual, I went there to check on her.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに、月城はおらず、ほっとしたような不
安なような気分になった。
dialogues.en:
But she wasn't present, and a feeling of uneasiness crept
onto me.
dialogues.text:
But she wasn't present, and a feeling of uneasiness crept
onto me.

dialogues.jp:
その帰り、公園で買い物帰りの月城に出会った。
さすがに、あの草の様子はもう見た後だと言う。
dialogues.en:
On the way back, I met the girl herself, heading back
through the park from shopping. Apparently, she had already
went to see the plant earlier.
dialogues.text:
On the way back, I met the girl herself, heading back
through the park from shopping. Apparently, she had already
went to see the plant earlier.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、断られるかなと思いながらも、一緒に帰
ろうと誘った。
dialogues.en:
Fully expecting rejection, I asked her to head back
together.
dialogues.text:
Fully expecting rejection, I asked her to head back
together.

dialogues.jp: 月城は、ほのかに微笑みながら、頷いてくれた。
dialogues.en: Instead, she nodded with a faint smile.
dialogues.text: Instead, she nodded with a faint smile.
